extraction_notes: Only the main article text and figures were provided; supplementary tables/figures (tables S1–S3, figs. S5–S7) are cited but not provided as extractable tables. Literature comparison table S2 was not extracted. Values read from Figure 5 plots are marked with qualifier '~'. The dense stability plot in Fig. 5E contains many markers; only the exact values stated in the text and the clearly governed 44 h point were recorded. Selectivity basis is carbon_molar because the Methods define S(CH3OH) = CH3OHoutlet/(CO2inlet − CO2outlet) × 100%.
